name: spiral-arc-type
title: Spiral Arc Type
description: Text laid along an Archimedean spiral via per-glyph placement (rotate + translate per character), coiling from the outside in — glyphs shrink slightly with radius so the coil reads as one continuous word.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Scatter
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Geometric
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
